edge_shape.description: ON_ENTITY_SURFACE is a stored entity -> entity edge. source = supported (portable) entity; target = supporter/owner (furniture) entity. The supporting surface is the owner's DERIVED AABB top face (NOT a structural_surface), so the supporter is named as an entity ref, not a surface ref (derived tops are not in structural_surfaces and would fail _validate_edge_refs).

config_defaults.note: Reuses the floor rest-contact band (P4). No new threshold introduced.

supported_class_exclusions.support_class_allowlist: support-class furniture owners are excluded as supported tabletop objects in P6; this prevents support furniture such as plant-stand from appearing as an answer to 'what is on the table?' even if its box rests on another support entity

support_class_exclusions.cabinet: container, not a tabletop -- ON vs IN ambiguity deferred to a later IN/CONTAINED_BY phase

threshold_calibration.freeze_statement: P6 reuses the floor rest band contact_threshold_m=0.02 / penetration_tolerance_m=0.03. Measured table-class rest gaps: -0.013 .. +0.035. This band captures 5 table rests (4 books + 1 lamp) and 1 plant-stand rest, and excludes the pot at +0.035 m float. Precision-over-recall, consistent with the wall picture exclusion. No new threshold is introduced.

rest_gap_distribution_observed.candidate_set: portable-class entity x support-class furniture top, footprint over the top polygon, centroid above the top, |bottom_gap| within the band window
rest_gap_distribution_observed.band_excluded_borderline: obj_43 pot on table_4 at bottom_gap +0.0349 (float past contact 0.02)

threshold_calibration.tempting_negative_recorded: obj_43 pot (gap +0.0349, rejected by contact) is included as a real negative so the precision boundary is auditable, not vibes-based.

synthetic_room_convention.description: Right-handed frame, gravity=(0,0,-1), up=(0,0,1). A synthetic furniture TOP face is the up-facing plane z=1 over x,y in [0,1]; a synthetic WALL is the vertical plane y=2 (interior normal -y). Plane a*x+b*y+c*z+d=0; (a,b,c) is the up-/interior-facing normal. Synthetic entity centroids given explicitly (rest_contact consumes the centroid).

clause_glossary.bottom_gap: min over 8 AABB corners of signed_distance(corner, plane) (== sd_min)
clause_glossary.ON_ENTITY_SURFACE: support_capable AND centroid_on_support_side AND contact AND footprint_ok

synth_wall.note: Vertical surface fed to the rest predicate to isolate the support_capable orientation gate (mirror of the P5 floor->wall WS5 case).

cases.rationale: Real positive (measured via live rest_contact). book_1 rests on table_5's derived AABB top; bottom_gap -0.0077 within the band, footprint inside the top. Boolean + measured clauses asserted; exact AABB from the live bundle.
Real positive. A table lamp rests on table_1's top (gap -0.0130). A 'lamp' that is genuinely table-supported -- contrast obj_6, the floor-standing lamp the wall path saw.
Real positive on a DIFFERENT supporter class (plant-stand, not table) -- proves the class allowlist is generic, not table-only. gap +0.0180 (float within contact 0.02).
Real band-excluded negative. The pot floats +0.0349 over table_4's top -- past contact 0.02 -- so it is rejected. The documented recall boundary; makes the precision-over-recall band auditable.
Synthetic exact rest (no fit bias): bottom face flush on the top plane, footprint inside. ON_ENTITY_SURFACE.
Floating 10 cm above the top: bottom_gap 0.10 > contact 0.02. Single-clause contact rejection.
At contact height but laterally off the top polygon (x beyond the top edge): in_plane_gap 2.0. Single-clause footprint rejection -- an object beside the table is not on it.
Under the table (centroid below the top plane): fails centroid_on_support_side, and the deep negative gap fails contact. Multi-clause by construction -- an object beneath a table is not on it.

Orientation-gate isolation: a box in contact with a VERTICAL surface fed to the rest predicate. Side/contact/footprint all pass, but support_capable fails (dot(normal,up)=0 < cos(30)). Mirror of the P5 WS5 floor->wall case; proves the gate excludes verticals.

cases.threshold_pinning: bottom_gap +0.025 is just past the contact bound 0.02, so it is rejected. Pins the float edge of the band (mirrors the real pot negative).
cases.rationale: Threshold-pinning float case: 2.5 cm above the top, rejected by contact at the frozen 0.02 float bound.

cases.threshold_pinning: bottom_gap -0.025 is within the penetration bound 0.03, so it is accepted. Pins the asymmetric band: penetration is tolerated more than float (0.03 vs 0.02), absorbing the all-negative rest fit-bias.
cases.rationale: Threshold-pinning penetration case: 2.5 cm into the top, still ON at the frozen 0.03 penetration bound. Contrast SS6.
